summary: Iter69 (index 52): Verified geofenced + schedule-restricted worker clock-in end-to-end. All 5 backend scenarios pass (too-early 400, too-far 403 w/ distance, on-site 200 verified, GPS-denied flagged, ungeocodable flagged) plus create/update re-geocode, address privacy for 'requested' worker, no-acceptance blocked, and clock-out regression. Frontend: worker WorkerGigDetail clock-in-btn triggers /api/gigs/{id}/clock-in with geolocation, timer starts on success. Admin GigDetail crew table shows the green 'GPS ✓ 35m' verified badge with data-testid gps-verified-{acceptanceId} and correct tooltip.

issues: The clock-in-btn (Y≈776) can be visually overlapped by the fixed bottom worker nav (Y≈793 REFER · EARN 10%). Playwright force-click via center coords hit the bottom nav — real users on short screens could also mis-tap. Consider adding bottom padding (pb-24) on the assignment detail container OR raising the nav z-index so the button isn't behind it. JS-dispatched click worked, confirming the handler is correct.

action_items: Add pb-24 (or higher z-index for the button vs. bottom nav) on WorkerGigDetail so the clock-in/clock-out button isn't visually behind the fixed bottom nav on short viewports — this is what caused Playwright's default click to land on the 'Refer · Earn 10%' nav item. Not a functional break of the API but a real-user mis-tap risk.
critical_code_review_comments: geo.py: Nominatim free tier is 1 req/s w/ shared UA; consider adding a retry-with-backoff and a small in-memory cache keyed by address to reduce load and avoid rate-limit misses when many gigs are created in a burst.

routes/gigs.py clock_in: the schedule gate uses gig.scheduled_at only; if only scheduled_local is present the gate silently no-ops. Consider falling back to scheduled_local when scheduled_at is missing.

routes/gigs.py clock_in: if payload.lat/lng are provided but site coords are None (ungeocodable), the current branch flags but never re-attempts geocoding once address is fixed — resolve_gig_coords sets geocode_attempted=True on first miss and won't retry. Consider clearing geocode_attempted whenever address_line changes (already done in update_gig? verify).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (worker on-site clock-in + admin verified badge both confirmed via Playwright + backend state)
